source: Read from the GSAP timelines in the round portfolio-20261002 (pieces/<id>/index.html, tl.* calls and the Batida comments); the receipts carry no beat table. Times are piece seconds.

rules.action: Something on screen moves or appears. Gaps between two actions shorter than minHold stay inside one action window.
rules.hold: Nothing new happens (static frame or a wait). A montage clip never contains one.
rules.transition: The film changes scene (caption and elements of the beat before leave, the next beat comes in). A clip never starts before a transition ends nor ends inside one.
rules.startSlack: A clip starts at most 0.1 s before the first action of its window and ends at most 0.1 s after the window ends.
